CITY COUNCIL MEETING
AGENDA FOR LA MIRADA CITY COUNCIL MEETING
October 22, 2019 –
6:45
p.m.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, CITY HALL, 13700 LA MIRADA BOULEVARD,
LA MIRADA, CALIFORNIA 90638
In-Person Public Participation Information
To address the City Council on an Agenda item other than a Public Hearing or during Public
Comments, please fill out a "Request to Address Council" card located in the back of the Council
Chambers near the agendas and submit to the City Clerk prior to the meeting or as soon as
possible. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council. The amount
of time for public comment may be reduced by the Mayor or by action of the City Council
Electronic Public Participation
To submit your Public Comments electronically in advance, please email your written comments to
cityclerk@lamirada.gov. The deadline to submit your Public Comment electronically is on the day
of a regular City Council meeting before 3 p.m. For special meetings, comments must be received
at least three hours prior to the meeting.
Members of the public may participate in this meeting via remote attendance by using the Zoom
Webinar information.
Zoom Meeting Details: www.zoom.us/join
Meeting ID: 897 8121 0338 Telephone Option: 1-669-444-9171
(*6 to unmute; *9 to raise hand)
Public Comment will begin with speakers attending in-person first followed by those attending via
Zoom Webinar.
Reasonable Accommodations
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate
in a City Council meeting or other service offered by the City, contact the City Clerk's Office at
(562) 943-0131. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are
needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide
accessibility to the meeting or service.
Agenda Materials
Copies of staff reports and supporting documentation pertaining to agenda items are available for
public viewing and inspection at City Hall during regular business hours and on the City's website
http://www.lamirada.gov. For further information regarding agenda items, please contact the
City Clerk's office at (562) 943-0131.

APPEARANCES, PRESENTATIONS, AND PROCLAMATIONS
6.1
PROCLAMATION FOR RED RIBBON WEEK - It is recommended the City Council proclaim October 21 through October 25, 2019 as Red Ribbon Week in the City of La Mirada and present a proclamation to Safety Education Officer Mary Cipres.
6.1 Proclamation for Red Ribbon Week
6.2
RECOGNITION OF PUBLIC SAFETY POSTER CONTEST WINNERS - It is recommended the City Council recognize the winners of the Public Safety Poster Contest and present them with Certificates of Recognition.
6.2 Recognition of Poster Contest Winners
7.
APPOINTMENTS
7.1
APPOINTMENTS TO YOUTH COUNCIL – It is recommended the City Council reappoint Yvonne Chen, Sarah Usmani and Salem Haile and appoint Hyunjun Kim, Emma Spirescu, and Francisco Zuniga to the La Mirada Youth Council for the term expiring in October 2020.
7.1 Appointments to Youth Council
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR
8.1
APPROVAL OF MEETING MINUTES - It is recommended the City Council approve the minutes of the Study Session meeting of October 8, 2019 and the minutes of the regular meeting of October 8, 2019.
8.1 Minutes of 10-8-19 Study Session
8.1 Minutes of 10-8-19 Council Meeting
8.2
APPROVAL OF WARRANT REGISTER - It is recommended the City Council approve the warrant register dated October 22, 2019 in the total amount of $2,421,479.30.
8.2 Warrant Register
8.3
INVESTMENT REPORT FOR THE CITY OF LA MIRADA FOR THE MONTH ENDING SEPTEMBER 2019 – It is recommended the City Council receive and file the City’s Investment Report for the month ending September 2019.
8.3 Investment Report
9.
ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS
9.1
RESOLUTION NO. 19-35 WAIVING THE FORMAL BID PROCESS AND AUTHORIZING REPAIRS TO THE AQUAPLAY STRUCTURE AT SPLASH! LA MIRADA REGIONAL AQUATICS CENTER - It is recommended the City Council adopt Resolution No. 19-35 waiving the formal bid process and the purchase and installation of standpipes and roof panels; authorize the City Manager to execute the contract with Whitewater West Industries at a cost of $37,789.47; and authorize the City Manager to approve change orders up to 15 percent of the approved contract amount.
9.1 Resolution No. 19-35
9.2
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2015-08, LA MIRADA BOULEVARD AT IMPERIAL HIGHWAY AND IMPERIAL HIGHWAY AT TELEGRAPH ROAD TURN POCKETS PROJECT - AWARD OF CONTRACT AND RESOLUTION NO. 19-36 AUTHORIZING A BUDGET AMENDMENT - It is recommended the City Council waive the minor bid irregularities in the apparent low bid and reject the bid protest; award the contract for Capital Improvement Project No. 2015-08, La Mirada Boulevard at Imperial Highway and Imperial Highway at Telegraph Road Turn Pockets, to HYM Engineering, Inc. in the amount of $512,795.00; authorize the City Manager to execute the contract on behalf of the City; authorize the City Manager to approve contracts for construction support services in an amount not to exceed 20 percent of the construction cost; authorize the City Manager to approve additional work up to 20 percent of the total project cost; and adopt Resolution No. 19-36 authorizing a budget amendment for Capital Improvement Project No. 2015-08, La Mirada Boulevard at Imperial Highway and Imperial Highway at Telegraph Road Turn Pockets project.
9.2 Resolution No. 19-36
